title: Myanmar — Coup & Civil Disobedience 2021
description: Golpe militar Feb 1. Movimiento de Desobediencia Civil (CDM) se propagó como contagio. Empleados públicos, médicos, ferroviarios. Respuesta militar violenta. CDM fue resistencia principal.
sources: AAPP (Assistance Association for Political Prisoners): data
data_notes: P represents fraction_participating (units: fraction_participating). Series reconstructed from published research sources (empirical_estimated). Observation operator H: fraction(|opinion| > 0.5). At Tier 1 (< 500 observations), only aggregate parameters can be calibrated against this case; see docs/validation/PROMPT_CALIBRACION_EQUIPO_AGENTES.md.
observation_operator_description: Protest participation fraction: P follows SIR contagion of Civil Disobedience Movement. Observation operator H: fraction of agents with |opinion| > 0.5.
